info.title: Mongo Content Store API
info.description: Hotel static content served from per-supplier MongoDB collections, plus control of the checkpointed Mongo to OpenSearch sync. Send an API key in the X-Api-Key header; the sync routes need an admin key.

get.summary: Looks hotels up by id, or pages the hotel ids of a city.
get.description: Pass 'ids' (comma separated, numeric) to fetch hotels by id; or pass 'cityCode' with optional 'pageSize' and 'cursor' to page the ids of a city. The two modes are mutually exclusive. Lookups by id are answered by the search index first and completed from MongoDB; the X-Content-Source response header (index, mongo or mixed) says which served the documents. City paging always reads MongoDB.

get.summary: Fetches a hotel by the supplier's alphanumeric code.
get.description: Answered by the search index first and completed from MongoDB; see the X-Content-Source response header.

get.summary: Searches the merged hotel master by name.
get.description: 'anchored' (default) matches a case-sensitive prefix and can use an index. 'contains' is a case-insensitive substring match that scans the collection, so use it only as a fallback. 'ci' is a case-insensitive whole-name match served by a collation index.

get.summary: Finds merged hotels that list a supplier's hotel id.
Returns a room's supplier-neutral detail, produced by the supplier's room mapper.

post.summary: Starts a sync of a collection into its search index, or resumes it from the checkpoint.
post.description: Admin key required. The run executes in the background; at most one run per collection is active at a time.

get.summary: Reports the state, last checkpointed id, counts and last error of a collection's sync.
Lists documents that could not be indexed, newest first, with keyset paging.
get.description: Pass the nextCursor of one page as cursor to get the next. The cursor is opaque.

post.summary: Asks the active run of a collection to stop; its checkpoint stays at the last completed batch.
Builds the collection into a new versioned index, verifies it and switches the alias to it.
post.description: Admin key required. The build runs in the background under the run lease of the collection, so it excludes a sync of the same collection. If verification refuses the new index the alias stays where it was and the new index is kept for inspection.

get.summary: Lists the versions behind an alias: which is current, which are retained for rollback, and the last verification.

post.summary: Points the alias back at a retained version.
post.description: Admin key required. Refused with 409 while a sync or rebuild of the collection is active, or when no retained version exists.

post.summary: Starts a configured relational-to-MongoDB migration, or resumes it from its checkpoint.
post.description: Admin key required. The migration is named in the request and defined in configuration (source, query, key column, column mapping, target collection). It runs in the background, at most one run per migration is active, and invalid rows are dead-lettered without stopping it. When it finishes the source count is compared with the target count.

get.summary: Reports the state, progress, last checkpointed key, error and count verification of a migration run.

post.summary: Asks an active migration run to stop; its checkpoint stays at the last completed batch.

ApiKey.description: API key. Content routes accept any configured key; /api/v1/sync routes require an admin key.
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key
